criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Part-Whole
categories.definition: One entity is a component, member, or subset of the other entity.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: One entity is located in, at, or on the other entity.

categories.name: Creator-Creation
categories.definition: One entity is the originator, author, designer, or producer of the other entity.

categories.name: Agent-Role
categories.definition: One entity holds a specific professional title, position, or role associated with the other entity.

categories.name: Origin
categories.definition: One entity originates from, is based in, or is a national of the other entity.

categories.name: Event-Participant
categories.definition: One entity participates in, competes at, or is associated with the other entity as an event.

categories.name: Product-Platform
categories.definition: One entity is a product, software, or game released for or compatible with the other entity as a platform.

categories.name: Publisher-Distributor
categories.definition: One entity is the publisher, distributor, or label for the other entity.

categories.name: Parent-Subsidiary
categories.definition: One entity owns, controls, or is the parent organization of the other entity.

categories.name: Geographical-Feature
categories.definition: One entity is a natural feature, such as a river or mountain, related to the other entity.

categories.name: Family-Relation
categories.definition: One entity is related to the other entity by blood, marriage, or lineage.

categories.name: Award-Nomination
categories.definition: One entity is nominated for or receives the other entity as an award or honor.

categories.name: Synonymy
categories.definition: The two entities are synonyms, translations, or alternative names for the same concept.

categories.name: Hyponymy
categories.definition: One entity is a specific type, kind, or instance of the other entity.

categories.name: Predecessor-Successor
categories.definition: One entity precedes or succeeds the other entity in a sequence, series, or timeline.

categories.name: Adaptation-Source
categories.definition: One entity is an adaptation, remake, or derivative work based on the other entity.

categories.name: Employer-Employee
categories.definition: One entity employs, hires, or appoints the other entity.

categories.name: Agent-Affiliation
categories.definition: One entity is affiliated with, represents, or is a member of the other entity.

categories.name: Instrument-Musician
categories.definition: One entity is a musical instrument played by the other entity.

categories.name: Subject-Field
categories.definition: One entity is a subject, field of study, or genre associated with the other entity.
